name: Income Borg El Arab Data Center
notes: Borg El Arab, ~52 km SW of Alexandria: ~USD 280M multi-phase project announced Jul 2026 after talks between Income chairman and Minister of Electricity; Ministry of Electricity to supply initial 100 MW rising to 400 MW in future phases (catalog says 400 MW full). Planned/MoU stage - no construction evidence.

name: Khazna-Benya Hyperscale Data Center (Maadi Technology Park)
notes: Maadi Technology Park, Cairo: USD 250M hyperscale data center, ~25 MW capacity expected to double to 50 MW with expansion; GAFI witnessed MoU among Benya, Khazna and Maadi Tech Park for site allocation. Term sheet/MoU + land allocation stage - planned, not yet constructed.

name: GPX Cairo 1 (Heliopolis)
notes: GPX Cairo 1, Heliopolis, Cairo: ~1 MW power per catalog; ISO 27001/9001, SSAE16. Catalog-grade (DataCenterJournal/datacenters.com) + GPX first-party group page. Needs GPX site-level/official confirmation for Grade A.

name: GPX Cairo 2 (New Cairo) and major expansion
notes: GPX Cairo 2, New Cairo (Road 90 area), Rated-4: expansion adds 12 MW and 1,800 racks plus 9,000 sqm, bringing Cairo equipped space to 12,600 sqm; home to MEIX internet exchange. GPX official release (A) + trade press (B); expansion announced 2023, execution stage per operator.

name: Huawei Cloud Cairo Region (AF-Cairo)
notes: Cairo/Egypt public cloud region launched May 2024 - first public cloud in Egypt/Northern Africa; Orange Egypt is local service/data-center partner. Grade A for region existence; exact physical host facility/address not disclosed on cloud pages - facility-level inference remains C.

name: Data Centers at the New Administrative Capital (Orascom)
notes: New Administrative Capital: Orascom Construction building two data centers including a Tier 3 ~38,000 sqm project and 133-rack / 1,088-rack datacenter buildings (contractor first-party project page). NAC administratively associated with Cairo-region planning ecosystem (division=Cairo per manifest convention).

name: Hassan Allam Digital Infrastructure / A15 data center
developer: Hassan Allam Digital Infrastructure and Data Centre Solutions / A15
notes: Hassan Allam Digital Infrastructure received a licence to establish and operate a data center with confirmed investment of USD 400M, developed in partnership with A15 (cloud/AI/data services). Governorate not disclosed (presumed Greater Cairo). License/announcement stage; verify NTRA/MCIT primary source for Grade A.

name: Orange Egypt data center (Cairo / New Administrative Capital)
notes: Orange Egypt owns/operates a data center in Cairo and a newer data center in the New Administrative Capital contracted by ACUD (for IoT/cloud/AI infrastructure). DCD + Orange first-party hosting page.

name: LINK Datacenter (LDC) Cairo
notes: LDC Cairo, 94 Rd 105, Hadayek El Maadi; NTRA cloud-services/data-center licensee; 20+ years hosting/datacenter services. Catalog address + operator page; Grade C until facility-level official evidence.

name: EgyptNetwork Data Center (Mansoura)
notes: EgyptNetwork colocation data center, 24 Om Kolthom St, Mansoura (Dakahlia); Microsoft Gold partner; only listed colocation facility in Mansoura. Catalog-only - needs operator/EgyptNetwork official facility page verification.

name: Telecom Egypt Regional Data Hub (RDH) - Smart Village
notes: Smart Village Business District, west Cairo/Giza: Egypt's largest certified Tier III data center; RDH phase 1 launched Q1 2021; hosts EG-IX and ICANN IMRS; Uptime Tier III record (Telecom Egypt Digital Data Center, Giza). Helios bid values RDH ~USD 230-260M.

name: Telecom Egypt Regional Data Hub 2 (RDH2)
notes: RDH2 at Smart Village/west Cairo: Tier III design certified; adds ~4.6 MW (RDH total ~7.1 MW data load after phase 2); under construction per trade press. Helios divestiture process ongoing.

name: Telecom Egypt October 1 / October 2 data centers
notes: 6th of October City (Giza): Telecom Egypt October 1/2 exchange/data center facilities listed in directories/contractor pages (DT-Holding fire-suppression references). Catalog/legacy telco leads - require Telecom Egypt first-party confirmation before counting.

name: Raya Data Center (6th of October) and new Africa50 Tier III facility
developer: Raya Data Center / Raya IT (Africa50 investor)
notes: Raya operates data centers in 6th of October (Giza), Maadi and New Cairo (Cairo); new greenfield Tier III facility funded by USD 15M Africa50 equity (+USD 10M Raya IT), construction slated to begin early 2025 (per Dec 2024 announcements); exact site not disclosed. Existing Raya facilities operational; new facility planned/early construction.

name: Renergy Group green data center (El Tor / South Sinai)
notes: El Tor/South Sinai: Renergy may establish a data center alongside its green-energy projects in Sinai; initially ~10,000 sqm with possible expansion up to 500,000 sqm; capacity not disclosed. Early-stage/planned (DCD, trade press) - no land/permit/NTRA proof yet.
